title: .respawnpack/spawn-state-<sessionId>.json — the subagent dispatch counter
description: Written by hooks/spawn-guard.js writeCount(), read by spawn-guard and by hooks/index-guard.js waveInFlight(). GITIGNORED. ⛔ NOTE THE PATH: directly under .respawnpack/, NOT under runtime/ — one counter per project, resolved through projectRoot(), so a hook invoked from a subdirectory cannot start a second one. ⛔ AND STALENESS IS DECIDED BY FILE MTIME, NOT BY updatedAt: the field is for humans. A read that cannot establish the count is CANNOT_DETERMINE and never 0, because a guard that reads 'I could not tell' as 'nothing in flight' is not a guard.
